81482.subject:
The world's largest private company set to IPO and it's already
 trading onchain
81482.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/43932197-ccc1-4c57-ac2f-fa2b263fcce2/Top_Optmium.png?t=1793116977)
Follow image link: (https://investors.defillama.com/optimum)
Caption: 

## Robinhood Chain’s first quarter by the numbers

Robinhood Chain generated over $40m in revenue last quarter. Over $85b in DEX volume has been traded and $130m in tokenized equities have been added onchain.

See Robinhood Chain’s Metrics Dashboard (https://defillama.com/chain/robinhood-chain?chainRevenue=true&dexsVolume=true&groupBy=daily)

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8d71540d-59d1-4eb9-adab-6b6ff01e5746/robinhood-chain_2026-10-27.png?t=1793108814)
Follow image link: (https://defillama.com/chain/robinhood-chain?chainRevenue=true&dexsVolume=true&groupBy=monthly)
Caption: 

The chain added over $1b in stablecoin market cap in two months. Stablecoin market cap is shared between [Paxos’ USDG ($680m) and Ethena’s USDe ($370m)](https://defillama.com/stablecoins/robinhood-chain).

With over $1.1b in TVL, Robinhood Chain is now a top 10 chain by TVL. Morpho and Steakhouse Financial both have over $500m in TVL on Robinhood Chain.

[RWA Active AUM](https://defillama.com/rwa/chain/robinhood-chain?groupBy=assetGroup) is at all-time highs: $175m in Private Credit and $160m in Stocks & Equities.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/b0c1971c-932d-42df-9df0-4edafc2e6f48/rwa-chain-robinhood-chain-chart_2026-10-27.png?t=1793109265)
Follow image link: (https://defillama.com/rwa/chain/robinhood-chain?groupBy=assetGroup)
Caption: [What are the odds that Robinhood Chain RWA mcap is above $330m on October 31st?](https://defillama.com/rwa/chain/robinhood-chain?groupBy=assetGroup)

Since mid September, TVL has plateaued and DEX volume & chain revenue have fallen from their peaks. Last week’s chain revenue was the lowest recorded week, down 98% from September’s peak.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/c1dcbb26-a622-4af7-9a36-2737368825a4/robinhood-chain_2026-10-27__2_.png?t=1793111173)
Caption: 

Many protocols are continuing to add TVL to the chain, but [volume fell across most DEXs](https://defillama.com/chain/robinhood-chain?groupBy=weekly&tvl=false&chainRevenue=true&dexsVolume=true) over the last week.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/4706f966-7aa3-4581-8d98-42c1d5edfb24/image.png?t=1793111665)
Follow image link: (https://defillama.com/chain/robinhood-chain?groupBy=weekly&tvl=false&chainRevenue=true&dexsVolume=true)
